faq.a: Abdulmalik is associated with the Arabic form عَبْدُ الْمَلِك, whose core sense is abdulmalik; servant of the king.

faq.q: What is the origin of Abdulmalik?
faq.a: Abdulmalik is associated with Arabic. Abdulmalik is Arabic عَبْدُ الْمَلِك (ʿAbd al-Malik), meaning 'servant of the King'.
Yes — the underlying form عَبْدُ الْمَلِك is Arabic.
Abdulmalik can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Abdulmalik should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. ʿAbd al-Malik is a compound of two Quranic elements, not itself a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Abdulmalik mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Abdulmalik is rendered عبدالملک and carries the sense عبدالملک، ملک کا بندہ.

faq.q: What does Abdulmalik mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Abdulmalik is rendered عبدالملک and carries the sense عبدالملک، بنده ملک.
A romanized syllable approximation is ab-dul-ma-lik. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.a: Romanization variants include Abdulmalik, abdulmalik. Script forms are عبدالملك, عبدالملک, عَبْدُ الْمَلِك, अब्दुलमलिक.
